validated_results.title: Men who consume vegetable oils rich in monounsaturated fat: their dietary patterns and risk of prostate cancer (New Zealand).
validated_results.reason: Population-based case-control study reporting prostate cancer incidence risk in relation to dietary total monounsaturated fat intake, although no quantitative estimate is given for this null association.

cases.excerpt: A population-based case-control study was conducted in Auckland, New Zealand, involving 317 prostate cancer cases and 480 controls.
